description: This file defines the SugarWidgetReportField class, a PHP class that extends SugarWidgetField, providing functionalities for rendering and querying report fields within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for generating SQL clauses, handling display logic, and managing field aliases, specifically for report generation purposes.

classes.name: SugarWidgetReportField
classes.description: A class extending SugarWidgetField that provides report field rendering, SQL generation, and sorting functionalities for SuiteCRM reports.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the reporter's attribute from the layout manager.

methods.name: getSubClass
methods.description: Returns a subclass object based on the layout definition type, or itself if no type matches.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the report field based on the current context and layout definition.

methods.name: _get_column_select_special
methods.description: Generates SQL for special weighted sum or amount calculations.

methods.name: _get_column_select
methods.description: Generates SQL for selecting the appropriate column, applying conversions and aggregations as needed.

methods.name: querySelect
methods.description: Returns the SQL SELECT clause for the report field.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the SQL GROUP BY clause for the report field.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the SQL ORDER BY clause based on the report field and sorting attributes.

methods.name: queryFilter
methods.description: Returns the SQL WHERE clause for filtering the report field.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for the sortable header cell in a report list view.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns the SQL fragment for this report field, dynamically based on context.

methods.name: _get_column_alias
methods.description: Generates a unique alias for SQL queries based on layout definition attributes.

methods.name: queryFilterEmpty
methods.description: Returns SQL for filtering empty or NULL values in the field.

methods.name: queryFilterIs
methods.description: Returns SQL for filtering values equal to a specified input.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Returns SQL for filtering values not equal to a specified input.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Empty
methods.description: Returns SQL for filtering non-empty values in the field.
